resources.string: Plan focused study blocks and pin your phone away from distractions.

Listen to your body: warm up gently, choose low-impact options anytime, and stop immediately if you feel pain, dizziness, chest pain, or unusual shortness of breath. Urgent or severe symptoms warrant medical care.

Mind & Body is not a crisis service. If you are in immediate danger or thinking about harming yourself or someone else, please contact your local emergency number (such as 911, 999, or 112), call or text 988 (in the US & Canada), or reach out to a trusted person or local crisis support service right now.
